answer: Each identity’s reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so a brief burst of good behavior cannot replace sustained honest service. EigenTrust centrality is earned through trusted, reciprocal interactions and their transitive ripple; a freshly spawned sybil starts with near-zero centrality, insufficient to pass consensus. Even a sparrow-sized cluster must build trust over time, while each pulse of verified service adds evidence rather than instant authority.
